query: Which validated survey modules and time-use protocols (24-hour recall vs time diaries) plus enumerator QA and validation checks reduce recall and social-desirability bias?

response.query: Which validated survey modules and time-use protocols (24-hour recall vs time diaries) plus enumerator QA and validation checks reduce recall and social-desirability bias?
response.answer: Time diaries and 24-hour recalls, along with enumerator training and validation checks, reduce recall and social-desirability bias in surveys.
